name: ahub
description: Use external models with host-selected conversation context and simple natural-language routing.

interface.shortDescription: Use any connected model with the context already in your task.
interface.longDescription: Delegate to DeepSeek or any other connected ahub provider without leaving the current conversation. The host selects relevant visible context, ahub filters sensitive text, and the result returns to the same task. Natural language is primary; composable shortcuts are optional.
defaultPrompt: @ahub-coder 用 Claude Code 自带的模型修复当前问题。
@ahub-config 以后 coder 默认使用 Claude Code，并继承它自己的模型配置。
@ahub-reviewer 用便宜模型审查当前修改。
